messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated p99 latency observed for /v1/generate (text-gen-prod, us-west-2). p99 jumped from ~450ms to ~2.8s starting 1789998800. Paging on-call.

luke: acked. i'm on it. pulling logs and queue metrics now.

maria: seen this start around the same time as a big tail of long sequences + reranker calls. batch sizes spiked to 48-64 on the big pool. GPU queue depth at 18.

jon: can we live-toggle continuous batching params? if big batches are causing serialization overhead maybe reduce window and cap size.

luke: yep. thinking a fast mitigation: 1) reduce batch_window_ms from 24 -> 6 for text-gen route, 2) set max_batch_size 64 -> 16, 3) temporarily disable reranker-v2 for enterprise routes. trade: small hit to throughput but should cut p99.

maria: +1. also add a per-customer rate cap for top hitters (customer:acme, customer:big-retailer) to 20 rps for next 15m. that will stop a few noisy tenants.

priya: i can push the config. will do a 10% canary first then roll if metrics look good.

luke: do it. share commands here.

priya: running: ```bash
curl -X POST https://config.internal.redwood/api/v1/override 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","overrides": {"continuous_batching":{"enabled":true,"batch_window_ms":6,"max_batch_size":16},"reranker_v2":false}}'
```

priya: config accepted, canary=10% applied to pool text-gen-usw-1. deploy-bot will kick a rolling update for the batcher adapters.

deploy-bot: rolling update started for adapter:text-batcher (canary=10%). version: batcher-2.14 -> batcher-2.14-canary-1.

jon: adding rate limit: ```bash
kubectl exec -n infra rate-limiter -- curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/limits -d '{"customer":"acme","qps":20,"duration_s":900}'
```

jon: response 200. limits applied.

luke: monitoring: within 90s we see queue depth drop from 18 -> 6 on canary hosts. p50 unchanged, p95 down ~200ms, p99 down from 2.8s -> 840ms. GPU utilization down ~12%.

maria: good signal. canary OK. priya, go ahead and ramp to 100% (15m window). keep reranker disabled for enterprise for now.

priya: rolling to 100% now. will stage 20% -> 50% -> 100% over next 8 minutes.

sre-runbook-bot: reminder: document adjustments in incident runbook under /incidents/1789998888. include metrics pre/post and commands executed.

luke: doing quick customer impact callout: we flagged 3 enterprise tenants (ACME, Big Retailer, FinCorp) — they saw elevated p99 and one filed a support ticket describing 'timeouts'. flagged for CSE outreach.

maria: also note this likely source = recent uptick in long prompt lengths + cached kv eviction rate rising; reranker_v2 multiplies per-request tokens by ~2x compute. disabling it shaved compute.

priya: update: 50% done, p99 hovering ~790ms, tokens/s overall dropped ~18% (expected). throughput for small requests stable.

jon: open question: do we want a short-lived autoscaler bump on dedicated pools instead of smaller batches? that could keep throughput without latency hit but slower to spin up. for now config change is lowest risk.

luke: agree. keep autoscale as backup. i'll start a ticket to evaluate autoscale thresholds.

maria: tagging experiments: follow-up items: 1) investigate why batcher allowed 64 for these routes (shape misclassification), 2) surface kv cache miss causes, 3) run load-tests with longer sequences to tune batch_window defaults.

priya: rollout complete to 100%. deploy-bot: update: rollout succeeded.

deploy-bot: rollout complete for adapter:text-batcher. version: batcher-2.14-canary-1 -> stable. no rollout failures.

luke: metrics after full rollout: p99 = 720ms (from 2.8s), p95 = 220ms (from ~420ms), tokens/s down 20%, CPU/GPU tail variance reduced. customer ticket volume dropped.

sre-runbook-bot: if latency stays stable for 30m mark incident as mitigated and start RCA.

priya: stepping off in 25m. handing off to night oncall: @maria please take over if anything regresses. i'll post a short handoff note in 15m.

maria: taking handoff. noted current mitigations: continuous_batching: batch_window_ms=6, max_batch_size=16, reranker_v2 disabled for enterprise, per-customer limits applied for known noisy tenants.

luke: thanks team. quick postmortem actions: temp change will be reverted after thorough RCA and perf testing. set a reminder to revert reranker_v2 after we have better shaper/quota.

priya: adding follow-up ticket: INC-1789998888-RCA (assign: eng-runtime + ml-infra). linking runbook & perf graphs.

jon: one last note: if we see similar events later, consider a dynamic policy: if p99>1s then reduce batch_window_ms by 4x for 10m and cap max_batch_size. could be automated.

luke: agreed. file as automation idea in backlog. closing active mitigation in 30m if stable. :thumbsup:
